name: ren-show
description: A live tour of every rrx-core and ren-core feature: signals to worker roots, on the DOM ($dom, $shadow; ren-dom), Skia (ren-skia) and three.js (ren-three) renderers (the drawn two on ren-canv), together on one page, and rendered once to HTML (ren-html) and data (ren-json).

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --import ren-core/loader --test test/*.test.jsx test/timers.test.js && node --import ren-core/compiled --test test/*.test.jsx && node scripts/build.mjs
